Corollary 3.5. Let 퐹, 퐺∈R[푋,푌] be 훽-quasihomogeneouspolynomials of degree 푑. If the height functions
of 퐹and 퐺can be arranged into pairs of Lipschitz equivalent functions, then either both 퐹and 퐺are of the
form 푐푋푑, or neither of them is.
Proof. Denote by 푒퐹the multiplicity of 푋as a factor of 퐹, and by 푒퐺the multiplicity of 푋as a factor of
퐺. By Proposition 3.10, 퐹is of the form 푐푋푑if and only if 푒퐹= 푑, and 퐺is of the form 푐푋푑if and only
if 푒퐺= 푑. Suppose that the height functions of 퐹and 퐺can be arranged into pairs of Lipschitz equivalent
functions. Then, by Proposition 3.11, 푒퐹= 푒퐺, so that 푒퐹= 푑if and only if 푒퐺= 푑. Therefore 퐹is of the
form 푐푋푑if and only if 퐺is of the form 푐푋푑.

Proposition 3.12. Let 퐹(푋,푌) = 푎푋푑and 퐺(푋,푌) = 푏푋푑, where 푎, 푏∈R \ {0} and 푑≥1.
i. If 푑is even, then 퐹and 퐺are R-semialgebraically Lipschitz equivalent if and only if 푎and 푏have the

ii. If 푑is odd, then 퐹and 퐺are R-semialgebraically Lipschitz equivalent.
